content: write a short note on whether we should write down Ember Throne and Nebula Rising inventory
Yes, likely at quarter end. Remaining layers are carried above current market. Estimate = sum over remaining layers of (unit cost − current market × expected sell ratio) where positive.
explain FIFO cost layers to Sam in 4 sentences, he thinks margin is 20%

Every batch we buy is a 'layer' at the price we paid. When we sell, we use up the oldest layers first. Right now we're selling Ember Throne and Nebula Rising from layers bought at the top of the market, so those sales lose money even though the ops dashboard (which uses an average of the buy list) looks fine. That gap is why the P&L margin is lower than 20%.
